tables.name: Appendix A — Technical questionnaire
tables.markdown:
| No. | Question | Response |
|---|---|---|
| A.1 | Describe your experience with cysteine-based conjugation at ≥ 1 kg scale (number of programs, scale). |  |
| A.2 | Confirm your conjugation suite meets OEB 5 (OEL ≤ 0.1 µg/m³) and describe the isolator set-up. |  |
| A.3 | State the batch size range for conjugation (kg of mAb per batch). |  |
| A.4 | Describe how you control DAR and unconjugated antibody (in-process controls, analytics). |  |
| A.5 | State whether mAb intermediate and conjugation run at the same site, or describe the transport. |  |
| A.6 | List your HIC-HPLC, RP-HPLC and SEC capabilities for ADC release testing. |  |
| A.7 | Describe your cleaning verification approach for highly potent compounds. |  |
| A.8 | State the earliest slots for ENG-M1 and the mAb intermediate PPQ campaign. |  |
| A.9 | List regulatory inspections of the conjugation suite in the last 3 years. |  |
| A.10 | Describe your waste handling for cytotoxic waste streams. |  |
| A.11 | State your proposed number of FTEs for technology transfer. |  |
| A.12 | Confirm acceptance of Korvexa's quality agreement template or list deviations. |  |

flowchart LR
    n0["1 Thaw WCB, seed expansion"] --> n1["2 Production bioreactor 2,000 L SUB (3.8 g/L)"]
    n1["2 Production bioreactor 2,000 L SUB (3.8 g/L)"] --> n2["3 Harvest (depth filtration)"]

    n4["5 Low-pH viral inactivation"] --> n5["6 CEX / AEX polishing"]
    n5["6 CEX / AEX polishing"] --> n6["7 Viral filtration (20 nm)"]
    n6["7 Viral filtration (20 nm)"] --> n7["8 UF/DF -> mAb intermediate (2–8 °C)"]
    n7["8 UF/DF -> mAb intermediate (2–8 °C)"] --> n8["9 Partial reduction (TCEP)"]
    n8["9 Partial reduction (TCEP)"] --> n9["10 Conjugation with drug-linker"]

    n10["11 Quench (N-acetylcysteine)"] --> n11["12 UF/DF: removal of free drug-linker"]
    n11["12 UF/DF: removal of free drug-linker"] --> n12["13 Formulation, 0.2 µm filtration"]
    n12["13 Formulation, 0.2 µm filtration"] --> n13["14 ADC DS fill, freeze (≤ −60 °C)"]
    n13["14 ADC DS fill, freeze (≤ −60 °C)"] --> n14["15 QC release (DAR by HIC, free drug, SEC)"]
